title: Linda Hill, “How to manage for collective creativity” (el «genio colectivo» detrás de una película de Pixar)

meta.charla: How to manage for collective creativity

lines: When many of us think about innovation, though,
Let's think for a minute / about what it takes to make a Pixar movie:
No solo genius, no flash of inspiration / produces one of those movies.
an individual in the studio drew a version of this picture.
because it suggested that the process was a neat series of steps
Even with all those arrows, he thought it failed to really tell you
Throughout the making of a movie at Pixar, the story evolves.
So think about it. Some shots go through quickly.
It depends on how vexing the challenges are
that they come up with / when they're working on a particular scene.
listen_for: Hill's contrast pairs: solo genius vs collective genius. Notice the linking in think about it and the rising list iterative, interrelated and, frankly, messy.

vocab.en: separate and clearly distinct from each other
repeating a process again and again to improve it

notas: Subtítulos humanos contrastados con Whisper; manda el audio (when they're working). La segunda pasada de Whisper confunde «challenges are that they» con «characters»; se sigue a los subtítulos.
